findings.title: QW-3 required an undocumented sister-codec touch
findings.detail: Enforcing the 8192-byte cap on the C# side required editing plugin/RigPlay/Audio/AudioHeader.cs (TryParse checked only the lower bound), a file the plan did not list. It is within QW-3's stated intent of enforcing the section 10.2 cap on both sides, is the minimum needed for the shared fixture to pass on the C# side, and is transparently documented in verification.md. Informational, not blocking.
